answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 578 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the lotus. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the mirror queue while genuine members promoted earlier still earns. The vault index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 141 account operation therefore ties up 17 million dollars of idle capital. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
